correctness.rationale: The actual four classical RK4 stages on A=diag(ω1J,ω2J) have nonzero closed-form determinant for both active modes, so the QO invariant-gradient projection is precisely radial. The multiplier Q(x)=|R(ix)|²>0, the modal action map is explicit and globally defined, and Q2-Q1 has exactly one positive sign-change at h_*. An action-angle Jacobian gives the converse symplectic obstruction at h≠h_*, while h=h_* gives a block-diagonal orthogonal symplectic linear map. Independent symbolic identities from actual verify.py plus 150 direct comparisons were successfully replayed. Finite checks are corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: The stated method is intended to preserve physically relevant invariants; this complete two-mode analysis proves that preserving total energy and remaining within base-RK4 linear stability can still cause exponentially large redistribution of physically conserved modal actions. The unique timestep at which this fixed-step nonlinear projection instead becomes exactly symplectic supplies a motivated sharp structural benchmark, not an arbitrary scalar parameter evaluation. Applications beyond the two-mode exact-arithmetic model are not asserted.
